title: Flow Pictures - YourAnimeList
description: Japanese animation studio. Its catalogue runs from Vacant Crown: Liminal War (2000) through River of Sparks, Skyfall Chronicle, Steelbound Testament and Blizzard Requiem to Rust Veil Junction and Skyfall Chronicle: Black Aegis (2012). Its late-era cinematic unit produced Sinful Apex (2011–2012), the studio's final marquee production, often described as its "final breath".
